reviews.name: Muskan
reviews.text:
As a budding travel creator and filmmaker, I’ve always been someone who doesn’t just see a place, I feel it, study it, and often spend hours trying to capture its essence in the most honest way possible. The light, the angles, the movement… every frame has a story, and I’ve always been obsessed with telling it right.

Being a part of BFP truly changed the way I approach my craft. It helped me understand perspective on a deeper level, how a single angle can shift meaning, how composition guides emotion, and how every shot quietly shapes what the viewer feels. That awareness has been a complete game changer for me.

Now, I don’t just capture beautiful scenery, I capture intention, emotion, and story. Grateful for a journey that’s made me more mindful, more skilled, and more connected to my art. ✨

reviews.name: Sathimaa
reviews.text:
Forge Creators wasn’t just a course… it was a full-on algorithm awakening 😄

It took me from “just posting” to actually understanding what’s going on behind the screen—how content clicks, why some things stick, and how the algorithm isn’t some mysterious villain… it’s just waiting to be understood (and maybe gently befriended).

What stood out? The way everything was rolled out—slow, steady, and super solid. No content chaos, no info overload… just learning that actually lands. You don’t just scroll through it—you grow through it.

Somewhere between reels and realisations, I found more clarity, more confidence, and a stronger creator voice.
And the best part?

I didn’t just gain insights… I gained a whole crew that gets it—and the jokes that come with it 😄

Forge gave me a community I’m definitely keeping for life—people who hype you up, call you out (nicely), and grow with you.💛

reviews.name: Swati J.
reviews.text:
My life has taken a surprising turn. Not much has changed on the surface but I feel like an upgraded version of myself – a pro max with many new features. I was in Goa from 9 to 16 Feb attending a film making bootcamp organized by Forge by LevelUp Learning. At first I was sceptical but I am glad I took a chance because it was as genuine as it gets. There were real professionals teaching the real craft with industry grade equipment. It was incredible. It was like being at Universal Studios with multiple groups shooting multiple sequences all around me. There was tremendous opportunity for intellectual and creative stimulation. I cannot remember the last time I felt so excited and alive. So present in the moment. 
The good news is that I made my first short film from beginning to end, the quality of which surprised everyone including me. The bad news is that my life satisfaction has decreased significantly because now I constantly feel like I am underliving my potential. I can do more and be more.

That changed when I joined the Forge Filmmaking Workshop.This experience transformed me. Today, I see a new version of myself someone ready to sacrifice time and comfort to bring a vision from paper to screen, and to feel the purpose that comes with it.Thank you for helping me rediscover who I am, reminding me of my goals, and giving me the confidence to chase them.

I highly recommend the Forge Filmmaking Workshop to every cinephile and anyone who dreams of making films.

reviews.name: Honey B.
reviews.text:
My experience at The Forge was truly unforgettable.

The first thing that stood out to me were Rahul’s classes. Some of them were genuinely eye opening. There were moments during those sessions where I felt something shift inside me. Those classes stayed with me and I clearly remember many of the insights from them. One thing I would request is that if it is not already there, it would be amazing to have a place where all the notes, slide decks, and important materials from the classes are stored. It would really help to revisit the learning whenever we want.

Another beautiful part of the experience was meeting 24 strangers who eventually became friends. Over the seven days we spent a lot of time together, talking, sharing stories, and getting to know each other. Slowly those strangers turned into people I genuinely connected with. I met some amazing individuals and formed some really meaningful bonds. In fact, we have already made plans to meet again in the future. I am leaving with a lot of great memories and friendships that I really value.

The resort itself was absolutely beautiful. I have been living a city life for a long time and I rarely get to hear birds or see so much greenery around me. What I loved most about the place was its location and how close it felt to nature. One of the most magical parts for me was hearing the koel bird. I remember hearing their voices the moment I entered the resort. Over the next seven days that sound became so familiar. I woke up to it every morning and it honestly felt magical.

Sometimes if I woke up early or had a little free time, I would go for a walk on the beach. Those walks were some of my favorite moments during the stay. I saw seagulls, cats, crabs, and even found a hermit crab and mud crabs on the beach. Living like that, so close to nature, felt really special. It reminded me of something we often forget in our busy city lives.

Another thing I really appreciated was the rooms and the housekeeping. Every day while we were busy attending classes, the rooms would be cleaned. We would come back to a fresh and tidy space with our beds made. Personally I really like my environment to be clean, and since our days were full and quite exhausting, it was such a relief not having to worry about that. For seven days I did not have to think about cleaning the space I was living in, and I am really grateful for that.

The food was also great overall. There were many options and most days the meals were delicious. On a few days the quality could have been a little better, but overall it was a good experience. After classes we often stayed up late together. We would talk, laugh, dance, and just enjoy each other’s company. Those late night moments with everyone were some of the most fun parts of the entire experience.

One of the most unexpected and beautiful parts of the program was the experience at Rivona with Soul Travelling. It allowed us to see a completely different side of Goa, one that most people do not get to experience. I usually like exploring hidden gems when I travel, but even I did not know about these places. I knew about South Goa, but not the specific locations we visited.

Hearing the stories of those places and learning about how they came into existence made the experience even more meaningful. I am really grateful that Forge included this in the program. I also loved that we were not told much about it beforehand. Experiencing it without expectations made it even more special.

Overall, the entire journey was something I will always remember. Even days after coming back, I still felt the hangover of the experience. The learning, the people, and the memories stayed with me.

If I ever get the chance, I would happily go back and relive it all again with those same 24 people.

Thank you, Forge.

👉 You don’t need to become someone else to grow. You need to become clearer about who you already are.

reviews.text: The Forge was more than a workshop, it was a perspective shift. What I loved most about The Forge was the intention behind everything. Nothing felt rushed or superficial; every conversation pushed us closer to why we create. It was a safe space to be vulnerable, to fail, and to explore ideas without fear of judgment. The mentors didn’t just teach, they listened, which made it easier to trust the process and take creative risks. You walked in with questions and left with better, deeper ones. More than anything, The Forge reminded me that storytelling isn’t about approval, but about honesty. That shift in mindset is what truly stayed with me.

Forge was more than just a filmmaking program it was an experience that pushed me out of my comfort zone and reminded me why I fell in love with cinema. What I loved most was the environment being surrounded by passionate filmmakers, collaborating under pressure, and actually creating a film rather than just talking about it. Forge helped me gain clarity, confidence, and a deeper respect for the craft. It truly feels like a meaningful step forward in my filmmaking journey.

Just attended the Basics of Filmmaking Workshop and honestly, it was way more valuable than I expected for the price. Everything was explained in such a clear and beginner-friendly way — from camera angles and lighting to storytelling and editing flow. You don’t just sit and listen; you actually understand the “why” behind each concept.

Big appreciation to Rahul, the host — super knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely passionate about teaching. He broke down complex stuff into simple, practical steps that anyone could grasp. If you’re even slightly interested in filmmaking, this workshop is 100% worth it — affordable, detailed, and packed with insights that make you see films in a whole new way.

reviews.role: Student currently in a drop year
reviews.text:
I've always had a passion for storytelling, but never knew where to begin with filmmaking. When I saw Level Up Learning's "Short Filmmaking Essentials" workshop for just ₹99, I was skeptical, but decided to give it a shot. I am so glad I did. This wasn't just a workshop; it was a revelation.

The content they provided was absolutely incredible. I was prepared for a basic overview, but what I got was a deeply enriching, comprehensive course that covered everything from scripting to editing. The instructors didn't just teach the technical aspects; they taught us how to infuse emotion and heart into our stories. For the first time, I felt like I truly understood how to translate my ideas into powerful, visual narratives.

The value for money is just insane. I've seen courses costing thousands of rupees that don't offer a fraction of the quality and insight provided here. I left the workshop feeling not just educated, but empowered and genuinely excited to start creating. My mind is buzzing with ideas, and I feel confident in my ability to bring them to life. Thank you, Level Up Learning, for proving that amazing content can be accessible to everyone. You’ve truly leveled up my learning and my passion!

I attended the short film workshop and it was an incredible experience! The instructors were knowledgeable, passionate, and provided valuable insights into the world of filmmaking.

The workshop was well-structured, covering all aspects of short film production, from scriptwriting to editing. The hands-on exercises and group projects helped me put the learnings into practice.

I appreciated the opportunity to network with fellow filmmakers and industry professionals. The feedback and guidance received during the workshop have inspired me to pursue my filmmaking dreams.

Overall, I highly recommend this workshop to anyone interested in short filmmaking. It's a fantastic learning experience that will leave you feeling motivated and equipped to bring your storytelling ideas to life!

reviews.text: As a full-time filmmaker, I must commend Forge for successfully condensing the intricate process of filmmaking—from ideation to final output—into just seven days. Covering the fundamentals of direction, scriptwriting, cinematography, and editing within such a short time frame is no small feat, yet Forge managed to make it an engaging and enjoyable experience. A significant part of this success lies in the selection of the right participants. I had the privilege of working alongside a passionate, curious, and diverse group of individuals, who made this edition truly unforgettable.

reviews.text:
There is magic in the joy of bumping into each other at random crossroads, only to find out that something within us has always been common although we are only meeting for the first time. It is art, and all that we make of it with a sense of belonging, faith and the stories that make us our current versions. It shall always be art.

Dear Forge- thank you for being an enabler of its kind, for your disruptive zest that brings together dreamers, for your generous intention towards making equitable diversity count and allowing space for cinema to be experimental, curious, dynamic and riveting. The possibilities are limitless, and what you’ve been attempting to do is a case study for the world of education to bring to all their classrooms, as they get experiential and accommodating. You have truly exemplified that there are no holds barred- it is a beautiful, liberating place to be. For children, educators, entrepreneurs, people. 

Many congratulations for being a phenomena that you are! I have walked back with more gratitude for life, love for stories of and as people, and a renewed vigor towards cinema as the most touching medium of expression. The experience shall become core moments of my life- moments becoming memories, memories that shall last a lifetime.

reviews.text:
My life has always felt like a Bollywood reference. I dream of making it big, but beyond fame, I aspire to leave a lasting legacy in cinema. One day, in a packed theatre, the lights will dim, and the screen will proudly display—'A FILM BY SURYANSH.'

This workshop brought me closer to that dream. Many might think that filmmaking is just about cameras, actors, directors, and sets, but cinema is so much more. It’s challenging yet deeply captivating when you love it as much as I do. The workshop provided a thorough introduction to the art of filmmaking, covering everything from pre-production to post-production. It was a transformative experience—thank you, Rahul, for these two hours that shifted my perspective.

Regards, 
An Aspiring Filmmaker
Suryansh

Workshop Feedback: Short Film Workshop

I recently participated in the Short Film Workshop, and overall, it was a positive experience. The workshop provided valuable insights into the filmmaking process, and I learned several new techniques that I hadn't been exposed to before. The content was well-structured, and the instructors were knowledgeable, which made the learning process smooth and engaging.

I particularly appreciated the focus on the practical aspects of filmmaking, which allowed me to understand the workflow better. However, I feel there could have been more time dedicated to hands-on practice.

Overall, I would rate the workshop an 8/10, and I would recommend it to others interested in learning the fundamentals of making short films.

It was an wholesome experience to learn new things about scriptwriting and storytelling. Being a beginner and passionate to learn creative writing. 

I learned about components of a story :
- Protagonist(central character)
- Goal (What does the protagonist wants )
- Conflict ( What stops the protagonist from achieving the goal)
- Stake ( What will happen if the goal is not achieved )

Themes , Characters (positive arc , negative arc , flat arc) , needs VS wants , Scene,etc….

Hello LevelUp team,
I kept my fingers crossed most of the time during the workshop. I couldn't look away from the laptop screen. The spectacle on the screen held my gaze, captivating every glance. The eyeballs rolled with the presenter on screen. My ears couldn't hear anything other than the echoes of what Rahul was speaking. I can feel something getting inside me and building a mesmerizing castle brick-by-brick.
Now that the workshop is over, the characters and plots in my mind are shifting shapes. A wave of fresh elements continuously infuses the scene, sweeping away a mountain of trash with a resounding thud.

Thank you, LevelUp team, for the magic.

reviews.text:
I am not a professional photographer though I would have taken a few 1000s of photos of family, relatives friends and at their weddings. 
This class has shown me how to correct the mistakes that I was committing while clicking images. 
I always used to think that when I saw the image on the camera it looked great but when transferred to the computer it did not look the same. It would look dull. Mr. Faheen taught us how to set the color of the screen so we got the same result on both the camera and computer. 
Also the neutral settings for the white balance and shutter speed and then making the adjustments according to our need. Those were all new lessons for me. 
I will surely use these new found lessons when shooting next time. 
The examples given made it easy to understand what was being taught.
Totally, the LevelUp class was definitely LevelUp for me. Thanks a ton for the team.

reviews.text: Diving into the workshop on 'The Psychology behind Storytelling' was an absolute delight! Rahul Srinivas, our instructor, masterfully navigated through the nuances of storytelling, unraveling its secrets with such clarity and passion. From dissecting the neuroscience behind storytelling to sharing captivating anecdotes of renowned storytellers, every moment was an immersive experience. What truly struck me was how Rahul seamlessly kept us engaged for the entire two hours, leaving us craving for more. This workshop was a great reminder that storytelling is not just an art form but a crucial life skill, applicable in every facet of our lives – be it in the workplace, personal relationships, career advancement, or even leadership development. It's an invaluable tool that empowers us to connect, inspire, and influence others. I look forward to many such enriching sessions with Rahul!

Pratham :)

reviews.text: The "Levelup - Basics of Filmmaking" workshop provided a comprehensive overview of the three crucial stages in filmmaking: pre-production, production, and post-production. The content was well-structured, offering valuable insights into the intricate processes involved in each phase. The instructor's expertise was evident as they elucidated key concepts, techniques, and best practices essential for aspiring filmmakers. Additionally, the workshop effectively integrated theory with practical examples, enhancing understanding and engagement. However, incorporating more interactive elements or hands-on activities could further enrich the learning experience, allowing participants to apply the knowledge gained in real-time scenarios. Overall, the workshop served as an informative and insightful introduction to the fundamentals of filmmaking, equipping participants with a solid foundation for their creative endeavors in the industry.

There's an ocean of film studies stuff out there in the world. Where LevelUp stands out, is in its intent by curating the most important stuff and logically sequencing it in a span of 3 days - in a way that it would serve as a definitive focal point and foundation for any aspiring film maker. The value delivered is unbeatable at this price. 

I'm thoroughly impressed by LevelUp's ways of democratizing Film Studies.

Special mention for The Wonderful Instructors who inspired the audience with their undying spirit, passion and good intent - Praveen, Siva, Akash, Sharanya, Santhosh, Shreyas and Rahul. 

My 3 Cheers 2 LevelUp !!!
